function.name: done
function.arguments: {"summary": "Task not completed. The red block remains on the table near x=-0.12, y=0.0; it was never placed inside the blue bowl. I located the block visually and attempted four closes: two missed because my grip spot was outside the pads (the wrist camera reads misleading at close range), one pinched only a corner (measured opening 0.075) which slipped during the first lift, and the final yaw-corrected close closed on air again. With the policy budget exhausted I am ending the trial.", "hindsight": "move_to executes only ceil(commanded_distance/0.03) steps and the arm converges to targets exponentially (~6.7% of remaining error per step), so long moves need repeated pulses; gripper open/close commands run a full ~79 steps and let the arm converge fully - pair repositioning with gripper commands when possible. The block sits near (-0.12, 0.0) on the z=0.80 table, is ~45 mm wide and yawed roughly 35-40 deg; it is graspable at TCP z~0.818 (opening reading ~0.45 when held squarely). The wrist camera is forward-tilted and misleading below ~5 cm altitude: targets should be verified against the fixed front/side cameras, and left/right in the wrist image corresponds to a y flip. A corner pinch reads ~0.075 and will not survive lifting; only a face-aligned grasp (matched yaw) holds."}
